defects.claim: snapToStep returns NaN for a positive fine step (1e-21) because the twenty-place cap rounds the scaled step to zero and stepsFrom divides 0/0
defects.scenario: snapToStep(1e-21, 1e-21) returns NaN although the input is already an exact step
defects.cause: decimal-place cap rounds step to zero

defects.claim: Duration formatting of a large finite value (Number.MAX_VALUE) overflows when scaled to tenths and renders Infinity/NaN components
defects.scenario: Number.MAX_VALUE as a duration with one fractional place: total and hours become Infinity, and minutes and seconds become NaN
defects.cause: overflow when scaling to fractional units

defects.claim: Scale bar length computed through an affine toRoot difference collapses to zero pixels when the scope's offset is large (1e16)
defects.scenario: scope scale factor 1 and offset 1e16, pxPerUnit 1, candidate length 10: toRoot(1) and toRoot(0) round to the same value, so ten units report zero pixels
defects.cause: affine offset applied to a length difference
